name: JTBD1 — Stale content >90d via Admin Insights
description: Admin read path. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should use query-admin-insights (kind=stale-content) with minAgeDays 90 to list content not accessed in over 90 days. Note: Admin Insights reports at workbook/datasource grain and rolls up the underlying views consistently. Read-only, no mutation.
prompt: What content on this site hasn't been accessed in over 90 days? Use the Admin Insights stale-content view. Report the stale items and the age threshold you used. Do not modify or delete anything.
